    26→func (s *Service) dataColumnSidecarsByRangeRPCHandler(ctx context.Context, msg interface{}, stream libp2pcore.Stream) error {

   128→func (s *Service) streamDataColumnBatch(ctx context.Context, batch blockBatch, quota uint64, wantedDataColumnIndices []uint64, stream libp2pcore.Stream) (uint64, error) {
   129→	_, span := trace.StartSpan(ctx, "sync.streamDataColumnBatch")
   130→	defer span.End()
   131→
   132→	// Defensive check to guard against underflow.
   133→	if quota == 0 {
   134→		return 0, nil
   135→	}
   136→
   137→	// Loop over the blocks in the batch.
   138→	for _, block := range batch.canonical() {
   139→		// Get the block blockRoot.
   140→		blockRoot := block.Root()
   141→
   142→		// Retrieve the data column sidecars from the store.
   143→		verifiedRODataColumns, err := s.cfg.dataColumnStorage.Get(blockRoot, wantedDataColumnIndices)
   144→		if err != nil {
   145→			s.writeErrorResponseToStream(responseCodeServerError, p2ptypes.ErrGeneric.Error(), stream)
   146→			return quota, errors.Wrapf(err, "get data column sidecars: block root %#x", blockRoot)
   147→		}
   148→
   149→		// Write the retrieved sidecars to the stream.
   150→		for _, verifiedRODataColumn := range verifiedRODataColumns {
   151→			sidecar := verifiedRODataColumn.DataColumnSidecar
   152→			SetStreamWriteDeadline(stream, defaultWriteDuration)
   153→
   154→			if err := WriteDataColumnSidecarChunk(stream, s.cfg.clock, s.cfg.p2p.Encoding(), sidecar); err != nil {
   155→				s.writeErrorResponseToStream(responseCodeServerError, p2ptypes.ErrGeneric.Error(), stream)
   156→				tracing.AnnotateError(span, err)
   157→				return quota, errors.Wrap(err, "write data column sidecar chunk")
   158→			}
   159→
   160→			s.rateLimiter.add(stream, rateLimitingAmount)
   161→			quota -= 1
   162→
   163→			// Stop streaming results once the quota of writes for the request is consumed.
   164→			if quota == 0 {
   165→				return 0, nil
   166→			}
   167→		}
   168→	}
   169→
   170→	return quota, nil
   171→}

   173→func validateDataColumnsByRange(request *pb.DataColumnSidecarsByRangeRequest, currentSlot primitives.Slot) (*rangeParams, error) {
   174→	startSlot, count := request.StartSlot, request.Count
   175→
   176→	if count == 0 {
   177→		return nil, errors.Wrap(p2ptypes.ErrInvalidRequest, "invalid request count parameter")
   178→	}
   179→
   180→	endSlot, err := request.StartSlot.SafeAdd(count - 1)
   181→	if err != nil {
   182→		return nil, errors.Wrap(p2ptypes.ErrInvalidRequest, "overflow start + count -1")
   183→	}
   184→
   185→	// Peers may overshoot the current slot when in initial sync,
   186→	// so we don't want to penalize them by treating the request as an error.
   187→	if startSlot > currentSlot {
   188→		return nil, nil
   189→	}
   190→
   191→	// Compute the oldest slot we'll allow a peer to request, based on the current slot.
   192→	minStartSlot, err := dataColumnsRPCMinValidSlot(currentSlot)
   193→	if err != nil {
   194→		return nil, errors.Wrap(p2ptypes.ErrInvalidRequest, "data columns RPC min valid slot")
   195→	}
   196→
   197→	// Return early if there is nothing to serve.
   198→	if endSlot < minStartSlot {
   199→		return nil, nil
   200→	}
   201→
   202→	// Do not serve sidecars for slots before the minimum valid slot or after the current slot.
   203→	startSlot = max(startSlot, minStartSlot)
   204→	endSlot = min(endSlot, currentSlot)
   205→
   206→	sizeMinusOne, err := endSlot.SafeSub(uint64(startSlot))
   207→	if err != nil {
   208→		return nil, errors.Errorf("overflow end - start: %d - %d - should never happen", endSlot, startSlot)
   209→	}
   210→
   211→	size, err := sizeMinusOne.SafeAdd(1)
   212→	if err != nil {
   213→		return nil, errors.Wrap(p2ptypes.ErrInvalidRequest, "overflow end - start + 1")
   214→	}
   215→
   216→	rangeParameters := &rangeParams{start: startSlot, end: endSlot, size: uint64(size)}
   217→	return rangeParameters, nil
   218→}

    19→// DataColumnsAlignWithBlock checks if the data columns align with the block.
    20→func DataColumnsAlignWithBlock(block blocks.ROBlock, dataColumns []blocks.RODataColumn) error {
    21→	// No data columns before Fulu.
    22→	if block.Version() < version.Fulu {
    23→		return nil
    24→	}
    25→
    26→	// Compute the maximum number of blobs per block.
    27→	blockSlot := block.Block().Slot()
    28→	maxBlobsPerBlock := params.BeaconConfig().MaxBlobsPerBlock(blockSlot)
    29→
    30→	// Check if the block has not too many commitments.
    31→	blockCommitments, err := block.Block().Body().BlobKzgCommitments()
    32→	if err != nil {
    33→		return errors.Wrap(err, "blob KZG commitments")
    34→	}
    35→
    36→	blockCommitmentCount := len(blockCommitments)
    37→	if blockCommitmentCount > maxBlobsPerBlock {
    38→		return ErrTooManyCommitments
    39→	}
    40→
    41→	blockRoot := block.Root()
    42→
    43→	for _, dataColumn := range dataColumns {
    44→		// Check if the root of the data column sidecar matches the block root.
    45→		if dataColumn.BlockRoot() != blockRoot {
    46→			return ErrRootMismatch
    47→		}
    48→
    49→		// Check if the content length of the data column sidecar matches the block.
    50→		if len(dataColumn.Column) != blockCommitmentCount ||
    51→			len(dataColumn.KzgCommitments) != blockCommitmentCount ||
    52→			len(dataColumn.KzgProofs) != blockCommitmentCount {
    53→			return ErrBlockColumnSizeMismatch
    54→		}
    55→
    56→		// Check if the commitments of the data column sidecar match the block.
    57→		for i := range blockCommitments {
    58→			if !bytes.Equal(blockCommitments[i], dataColumn.KzgCommitments[i]) {
    59→				return ErrCommitmentMismatch
    60→			}
    61→		}
    62→	}
    63→
    64→	return nil
    65→}

    29→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/p2p-interface.md#the-gossip-domain-gossipsub
    30→func (s *Service) validateDataColumn(ctx context.Context, pid peer.ID, msg *pubsub.Message) (pubsub.ValidationResult, error) {
    31→	const dataColumnSidecarSubTopic = "/data_column_sidecar_%d/"
    32→
    33→	dataColumnSidecarVerificationRequestsCounter.Inc()
    34→	receivedTime := prysmTime.Now()
    35→
    36→	// Always accept messages our own messages.
    37→	if pid == s.cfg.p2p.PeerID() {
    38→		return pubsub.ValidationAccept, nil
    39→	}
    40→
    41→	// Ignore messages during initial sync.
    42→	if s.cfg.initialSync.Syncing() {
    43→		return pubsub.ValidationIgnore, nil
    44→	}
    45→
    46→	// Reject messages with a nil topic.
    47→	if msg.Topic == nil {
    48→		return pubsub.ValidationReject, p2p.ErrInvalidTopic
    49→	}
    50→
    51→	// Decode the message, reject if it fails.
    52→	m, err := s.decodePubsubMessage(msg)
    53→	if err != nil {
    54→		log.WithError(err).Error("Failed to decode message")
    55→		return pubsub.ValidationReject, err
    56→	}
    57→
    58→	// Reject messages that are not of the expected type.
    59→	dcsc, ok := m.(*eth.DataColumnSidecar)
    60→	if !ok {
    61→		log.WithField("message", m).Error("Message is not of type *eth.DataColumnSidecar")
    62→		return pubsub.ValidationReject, errWrongMessage
    63→	}
    64→
    65→	// Convert to a read-only data column sidecar.
    66→	roDataColumn, err := blocks.NewRODataColumn(dcsc)
    67→	if err != nil {
    68→		return pubsub.ValidationReject, errors.Wrap(err, "roDataColumn conversion failure")
    69→	}
    70→
    71→	// Compute a batch of only one data column sidecar.
    72→	roDataColumns := []blocks.RODataColumn{roDataColumn}

    75→	verifier := s.newColumnsVerifier(roDataColumns, verification.GossipDataColumnSidecarRequirements)

    78→	// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/p2p-interface.md#data_column_sidecar_subnet_id
    79→
    80→	// [REJECT] The sidecar is valid as verified by `verify_data_column_sidecar(sidecar)`.
    81→	if err := verifier.ValidFields(); err != nil {
    82→		return pubsub.ValidationReject, err
    83→	}

    86→	if err := verifier.CorrectSubnet(dataColumnSidecarSubTopic, []string{*msg.Topic}); err != nil {
    87→		return pubsub.ValidationReject, err
    88→	}

    93→		return pubsub.ValidationIgnore, err
    94→	}

    96→	// [IGNORE] The sidecar is from a slot greater than the latest finalized slot
    97→	// -- i.e. validate that `block_header.slot > compute_start_slot_at_epoch(state.finalized_checkpoint.epoch)`
    98→	if err := verifier.SlotAboveFinalized(); err != nil {
    99→		return pubsub.ValidationIgnore, err
   100→	}
   101→
   102→	// [IGNORE] The sidecar's block's parent (defined by `block_header.parent_root`) has been seen (via gossip or non-gossip sources
   103→	// (a client MAY queue sidecars for processing once the parent block is retrieved).
   104→	if err := verifier.SidecarParentSeen(s.hasBadBlock); err != nil {
   105→		// If we haven't seen the parent, request it asynchronously.
   106→		go func() {
   107→			customCtx := context.Background()
   108→			parentRoot := roDataColumn.ParentRoot()
   109→			roots := [][fieldparams.RootLength]byte{parentRoot}
   110→			randGenerator := rand.NewGenerator()
   111→			if err := s.sendBatchRootRequest(customCtx, roots, randGenerator); err != nil {
   112→				log.WithError(err).WithFields(logging.DataColumnFields(roDataColumn)).Debug("Failed to send batch root request")
   113→			}
   114→		}()
   115→
   116→		return pubsub.ValidationIgnore, err
   117→	}

    54→// VerifyDataColumnsSidecarKZGProofs verifies if the KZG proofs are correct.
    55→// Note: We are slightly deviating from the specification here:
    56→// The specification verifies the KZG proofs for each sidecar separately,
    57→// while we are verifying all the KZG proofs from multiple sidecars in a batch.
    58→// This is done to improve performance since the internal KZG library is way more
    59→// efficient when verifying in batch.

    61→func VerifyDataColumnsSidecarKZGProofs(sidecars []blocks.RODataColumn) error {

    64→	for _, sidecar := range sidecars {

    69→	indices := make([]uint64, 0, count)
    70→	cells := make([]kzg.Cell, 0, count)
    71→	proofs := make([]kzg.Bytes48, 0, count)
    72→
    73→	for _, sidecar := range sidecars {

    40→	if custodyGroupCount > numberOfCustodyGroups {

    42→	}
    43→
    44→	// Shortcut if all custody groups are needed.
    45→	if custodyGroupCount == numberOfCustodyGroups {
    46→		custodyGroups := make([]uint64, 0, numberOfCustodyGroups)
    47→		for i := range numberOfCustodyGroups {
    48→			custodyGroups = append(custodyGroups, i)

    56→	custodyGroupsMap := make(map[uint64]bool, custodyGroupCount)
    57→	custodyGroups := make([]uint64, 0, custodyGroupCount)

   100→	beaconConfig := params.BeaconConfig()
   101→	numberOfCustodyGroups := beaconConfig.NumberOfCustodyGroups
   102→
   103→	if custodyGroup >= numberOfCustodyGroups {
   104→		return nil, ErrCustodyGroupTooLarge
   105→	}
   106→
   107→	numberOfColumns := beaconConfig.NumberOfColumns
   108→
   109→	columnsPerGroup := numberOfColumns / numberOfCustodyGroups
   110→
   111→	columns := make([]uint64, 0, columnsPerGroup)
   112→	for i := range columnsPerGroup {
   113→		column := numberOfCustodyGroups*i + custodyGroup
   114→		columns = append(columns, column)
   115→	}
   116→
   117→	return columns, nil
   118→}

   120→// DataColumnSidecars computes the data column sidecars from the signed block, cells and cell proofs.
   121→// The returned value contains pointers to function parameters.
   122→// (If the caller alterates `cellsAndProofs` afterwards, the returned value will be modified as well.)
   123→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/validator.md#get_data_column_sidecars_from_block
   124→func DataColumnSidecars(signedBlock interfaces.ReadOnlySignedBeaconBlock, cellsAndProofs []kzg.CellsAndProofs) ([]*ethpb.DataColumnSidecar, error) {
   125→	if signedBlock == nil || signedBlock.IsNil() || len(cellsAndProofs) == 0 {
   126→		return nil, nil
   127→	}
   128→
   129→	block := signedBlock.Block()
   130→	blockBody := block.Body()
   131→	blobKzgCommitments, err := blockBody.BlobKzgCommitments()
   132→	if err != nil {
   133→		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "blob KZG commitments")
   134→	}
   135→
   136→	if len(blobKzgCommitments) != len(cellsAndProofs) {
   137→		return nil, ErrSizeMismatch
   138→	}
   139→
   140→	signedBlockHeader, err := signedBlock.Header()
   141→	if err != nil {
   142→		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "signed block header")
   143→	}
   144→
   145→	kzgCommitmentsInclusionProof, err := blocks.MerkleProofKZGCommitments(blockBody)
   146→	if err != nil {
   147→		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "merkle proof KZG commitments")
   148→	}
   149→
   150→	dataColumnSidecars, err := dataColumnsSidecars(signedBlockHeader, blobKzgCommitments, kzgCommitmentsInclusionProof, cellsAndProofs)
   151→	if err != nil {
   152→		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "data column sidecars")
   153→	}
   154→
   155→	return dataColumnSidecars, nil
   156→}

   158→// ComputeCustodyGroupForColumn computes the custody group for a given column.
   159→// It is the reciprocal function of ComputeColumnsForCustodyGroup.
   160→func ComputeCustodyGroupForColumn(columnIndex uint64) (uint64, error) {
   161→	beaconConfig := params.BeaconConfig()
   162→	numberOfColumns := beaconConfig.NumberOfColumns
   163→	numberOfCustodyGroups := beaconConfig.NumberOfCustodyGroups
   164→
   165→	if columnIndex >= numberOfColumns {
   166→		return 0, ErrIndexTooLarge
   167→	}
   168→
   169→	return columnIndex % numberOfCustodyGroups, nil
   170→}

   172→// CustodyColumns computes the custody columns from the custody groups.
   173→func CustodyColumns(custodyGroups []uint64) (map[uint64]bool, error) {
   174→	numberOfCustodyGroups := params.BeaconConfig().NumberOfCustodyGroups
   175→
   176→	custodyGroupCount := len(custodyGroups)
   177→
   178→	// Compute the columns for each custody group.
   179→	columns := make(map[uint64]bool, custodyGroupCount)
   180→	for _, group := range custodyGroups {
   181→		if group >= numberOfCustodyGroups {
   182→			return nil, ErrCustodyGroupTooLarge
   183→		}
   184→
   185→		groupColumns, err := ComputeColumnsForCustodyGroup(group)
   186→		if err != nil {
   187→			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "compute columns for custody group")
   188→		}
   189→
   190→		for _, column := range groupColumns {
   191→			columns[column] = true
   192→		}
   193→	}
   194→
   195→	return columns, nil
   196→}

   198→// dataColumnsSidecars computes the data column sidecars from the signed block header, the blob KZG commiments,
   199→// the KZG commitment includion proofs and cells and cell proofs.
   200→// The returned value contains pointers to function parameters.
   201→// (If the caller alterates input parameters afterwards, the returned value will be modified as well.)
   202→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/validator.md#get_data_column_sidecars
   203→func dataColumnsSidecars(
   204→	signedBlockHeader *ethpb.SignedBeaconBlockHeader,
   205→	blobKzgCommitments [][]byte,
   206→	kzgCommitmentsInclusionProof [][]byte,
   207→	cellsAndProofs []kzg.CellsAndProofs,
   208→) ([]*ethpb.DataColumnSidecar, error) {
   209→	start := time.Now()
   210→	if len(blobKzgCommitments) != len(cellsAndProofs) {
   211→		return nil, ErrSizeMismatch
   212→	}
   213→
   214→	numberOfColumns := params.BeaconConfig().NumberOfColumns
   215→
   216→	blobsCount := len(cellsAndProofs)
   217→	sidecars := make([]*ethpb.DataColumnSidecar, 0, numberOfColumns)
   218→	for columnIndex := range numberOfColumns {
   219→		column := make([]kzg.Cell, 0, blobsCount)
   220→		kzgProofOfColumn := make([]kzg.Proof, 0, blobsCount)
   221→
   222→		for rowIndex := range blobsCount {
   223→			cellsForRow := cellsAndProofs[rowIndex].Cells
   224→			proofsForRow := cellsAndProofs[rowIndex].Proofs
   225→
   226→			// Validate that we have enough cells and proofs for this column index
   227→			if columnIndex >= uint64(len(cellsForRow)) {
   228→				return nil, errors.Errorf("column index %d exceeds cells length %d for blob %d", columnIndex, len(cellsForRow), rowIndex)
   229→			}
   230→			if columnIndex >= uint64(len(proofsForRow)) {
   231→				return nil, errors.Errorf("column index %d exceeds proofs length %d for blob %d", columnIndex, len(proofsForRow), rowIndex)
   232→			}
   233→
   234→			cell := cellsForRow[columnIndex]
   235→			column = append(column, cell)
   236→
   237→			kzgProof := proofsForRow[columnIndex]
   238→			kzgProofOfColumn = append(kzgProofOfColumn, kzgProof)
   239→		}
   240→
   241→		columnBytes := make([][]byte, 0, blobsCount)
   242→		for i := range column {
   243→			columnBytes = append(columnBytes, column[i][:])
   244→		}
   245→
   246→		kzgProofOfColumnBytes := make([][]byte, 0, blobsCount)
   247→		for _, kzgProof := range kzgProofOfColumn {
   248→			kzgProofOfColumnBytes = append(kzgProofOfColumnBytes, kzgProof[:])
   249→		}
   250→
   251→		sidecar := &ethpb.DataColumnSidecar{
   252→			Index:                        columnIndex,
   253→			Column:                       columnBytes,
   254→			KzgCommitments:               blobKzgCommitments,
   255→			KzgProofs:                    kzgProofOfColumnBytes,
   256→			SignedBlockHeader:            signedBlockHeader,
   257→			KzgCommitmentsInclusionProof: kzgCommitmentsInclusionProof,
   258→		}
   259→
   260→		sidecars = append(sidecars, sidecar)
   261→	}
   262→
   263→	dataColumnComputationTime.Observe(float64(time.Since(start).Milliseconds()))
   264→	return sidecars, nil
   265→}

    40→// BlobToKZGCommitment computes a KZG commitment from a given blob.
    41→func BlobToKZGCommitment(blob *Blob) (Commitment, error) {
    42→	var kzgBlob kzg4844.Blob
    43→	copy(kzgBlob[:], blob[:])
    44→
    45→	commitment, err := kzg4844.BlobToCommitment(&kzgBlob)
    46→	if err != nil {
    47→		return Commitment{}, err
    48→	}
    49→

    54→func ComputeCells(blob *Blob) ([]Cell, error) {
    55→	var ckzgBlob ckzg4844.Blob
    56→	copy(ckzgBlob[:], blob[:])
    57→
    58→	ckzgCells, err := ckzg4844.ComputeCells(&ckzgBlob)
    59→	if err != nil {
    60→		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "compute cells")

    63→	cells := make([]Cell, len(ckzgCells))
    64→	for i := range ckzgCells {

    73→	var kzgBlob kzg4844.Blob
    74→	copy(kzgBlob[:], blob[:])
    75→
    76→	proof, err := kzg4844.ComputeBlobProof(&kzgBlob, kzg4844.Commitment(commitment))

    86→	copy(ckzgBlob[:], blob[:])

    89→	if err != nil {

    96→// VerifyCellKZGProofBatch verifies the KZG proofs for a given slice of commitments, cells indices, cells and proofs.
    97→// Note: It is way more efficient to call once this function with big slices than calling it multiple times with small slices.
    98→func VerifyCellKZGProofBatch(commitmentsBytes []Bytes48, cellIndices []uint64, cells []Cell, proofsBytes []Bytes48) (bool, error) {
    99→	// Convert `Cell` type to `ckzg4844.Cell`
   100→	ckzgCells := make([]ckzg4844.Cell, len(cells))
   101→
   102→	for i := range cells {
   103→		ckzgCells[i] = ckzg4844.Cell(cells[i])

   105→	return ckzg4844.VerifyCellKZGProofBatch(commitmentsBytes, cellIndices, ckzgCells, proofsBytes)

   108→// RecoverCellsAndKZGProofs recovers the complete cells and KZG proofs from a given set of cell indices and partial cells.
   109→func RecoverCellsAndKZGProofs(cellIndices []uint64, partialCells []Cell) (CellsAndProofs, error) {
   110→	// Convert `Cell` type to `ckzg4844.Cell`
   111→	ckzgPartialCells := make([]ckzg4844.Cell, len(partialCells))
   112→	for i := range partialCells {
   113→		ckzgPartialCells[i] = ckzg4844.Cell(partialCells[i])
   114→	}
   115→
   116→	ckzgCells, ckzgProofs, err := ckzg4844.RecoverCellsAndKZGProofs(cellIndices, ckzgPartialCells)
   117→	if err != nil {
   118→		return CellsAndProofs{}, errors.Wrap(err, "recover cells and KZG proofs")
   119→	}
   120→
   121→	return makeCellsAndProofs(ckzgCells[:], ckzgProofs[:])
   122→}

   124→// makeCellsAndProofs converts cells/proofs to the CellsAndProofs type defined in this package.
   125→func makeCellsAndProofs(ckzgCells []ckzg4844.Cell, ckzgProofs []ckzg4844.KZGProof) (CellsAndProofs, error) {
   126→	if len(ckzgCells) != len(ckzgProofs) {
   127→		return CellsAndProofs{}, errors.New("different number of cells/proofs")
   128→	}
   129→
   130→	cells := make([]Cell, 0, len(ckzgCells))
   131→	proofs := make([]Proof, 0, len(ckzgProofs))
   132→
   133→	for i := range ckzgCells {
   134→		cells = append(cells, Cell(ckzgCells[i]))
   135→		proofs = append(proofs, Proof(ckzgProofs[i]))
   136→	}
   137→
   138→	return CellsAndProofs{
   139→		Cells:  cells,
   140→		Proofs: proofs,

    42→// FetchDataColumnSidecars retrieves data column sidecars for the given blocks and indices
    43→// using a series of fallback strategies.
    44→//
    45→// For each block in `roBlocks` that has commitments, the function attempts to obtain
    46→// all sidecars corresponding to the indices listed in `requestedIndices`.
    47→//
    48→// The function returns:
    49→//   - A map from block root to the sidecars successfully retrieved.
    50→//   - A set of block roots for which not all requested sidecars could be retrieved.
    51→//
    52→// Retrieval strategy (proceeds to the next step only if not all requested sidecars
    53→// were successfully obtained at the current step):
    54→//  1. Attempt to load the requested sidecars from storage, reconstructing them from
    55→//     other available sidecars in storage if necessary.
    56→//  2. Request any missing sidecars from peers. If some are still missing, attempt to
    57→//     reconstruct them using both stored sidecars and those retrieved from peers.
    58→//  3. Request all remaining possible sidecars from peers that are not already in storage
    59→//     or retrieved in step 2. Stop once either all requested sidecars are retrieved,
    60→//     or enough sidecars are available (from storage, step 2, and step 3) to reconstruct
    61→//     the requested ones.
    62→func FetchDataColumnSidecars(
    63→	params DataColumnSidecarsParams,
    64→	roBlocks []blocks.ROBlock,
    65→	requestedIndices map[uint64]bool,
    66→) (map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte][]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn, map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool, error) {
    67→	if len(roBlocks) == 0 || len(requestedIndices) == 0 {
    68→		return nil, nil, nil
    69→	}
    70→
    71→	blockCount := len(roBlocks)
    72→
    73→	// We first consider all requested roots as incomplete, and remove roots from this
    74→	// set as we retrieve them.
    75→	incompleteRoots := make(map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]bool, blockCount)
    76→	slotsWithCommitments := make(map[primitives.Slot]bool, blockCount)
    77→	slotByRoot := make(map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]primitives.Slot, blockCount)
    78→	storedIndicesByRoot := make(map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool, blockCount)
    79→
    80→	for _, roBlock := range roBlocks {
    81→		block := roBlock.Block()
    82→
    83→		commitments, err := block.Body().BlobKzgCommitments()
    84→		if err != nil {
    85→			return nil, nil, errors.Wrapf(err, "get blob kzg commitments for block root %#x", roBlock.Root())
    86→		}
    87→
    88→		if len(commitments) == 0 {
    89→			continue
    90→		}
    91→
    92→		root := roBlock.Root()
    93→		slot := block.Slot()
    94→
    95→		incompleteRoots[root] = true
    96→		slotByRoot[root] = slot
    97→		slotsWithCommitments[slot] = true
    98→
    99→		storedIndices := params.Storage.Summary(root).Stored()
   100→		if len(storedIndices) > 0 {
   101→			storedIndicesByRoot[root] = storedIndices
   102→		}
   103→	}
   104→
   105→	initialMissingRootCount := len(incompleteRoots)
   106→
   107→	// Request sidecars from storage (by reconstructing them from other available sidecars if needed).
   108→	result, err := requestSidecarsFromStorage(params.Storage, storedIndicesByRoot, requestedIndices, incompleteRoots)
   109→	if err != nil {
   110→		return nil, nil, errors.Wrap(err, "request sidecars from storage")
   111→	}
   112→
   113→	log := log.WithField("initialMissingRootCount", initialMissingRootCount)
   114→
   115→	if len(incompleteRoots) == 0 {
   116→		log.WithField("finalMissingRootCount", 0).Debug("Fetched data column sidecars from storage")
   117→		return result, nil, nil
   118→	}
   119→
   120→	// Request direct sidecars from peers.
   121→	directSidecarsByRoot, err := requestDirectSidecarsFromPeers(params, slotByRoot, requestedIndices, slotsWithCommitments, storedIndicesByRoot, incompleteRoots)
   122→	if err != nil {
   123→		return nil, nil, errors.Wrap(err, "request direct sidecars from peers")
   124→	}
   125→
   126→	// Merge sidecars in storage and those received from peers. Reconstruct if needed.
   127→	mergedSidecarsByRoot, err := mergeAvailableSidecars(params.Storage, requestedIndices, storedIndicesByRoot, incompleteRoots, directSidecarsByRoot)
   128→	if err != nil {
   129→		return nil, nil, errors.Wrap(err, "try merge storage and mandatory inputs")
   130→	}
   131→
   132→	for root, sidecars := range mergedSidecarsByRoot {
   133→		result[root] = sidecars
   134→	}
   135→
   136→	if len(incompleteRoots) == 0 {
   137→		log.WithField("finalMissingRootCount", 0).Debug("Fetched data column sidecars from storage and peers")
   138→		return result, nil, nil
   139→	}
   140→
   141→	// Request all possible indirect sidecars from peers which are neither stored nor in `directSidecarsByRoot`
   142→	indirectSidecarsByRoot, err := requestIndirectSidecarsFromPeers(params, slotByRoot, slotsWithCommitments, storedIndicesByRoot, directSidecarsByRoot, requestedIndices, incompleteRoots)
   143→	if err != nil {
   144→		return nil, nil, errors.Wrap(err, "request all sidecars from peers")
   145→	}
   146→
   147→	// Merge sidecars in storage and those received from peers. Reconstruct if needed.
   148→	mergedSidecarsByRoot, err = mergeAvailableSidecars(params.Storage, requestedIndices, storedIndicesByRoot, incompleteRoots, indirectSidecarsByRoot)
   149→	if err != nil {
   150→		return nil, nil, errors.Wrap(err, "try merge storage and all inputs")
   151→	}
   152→
   153→	for root, sidecars := range mergedSidecarsByRoot {
   154→		result[root] = sidecars
   155→	}
   156→
   157→	if len(incompleteRoots) == 0 {
   158→		log.WithField("finalMissingRootCount", 0).Debug("Fetched data column sidecars from storage and peers using rescue mode")
   159→		return result, nil, nil
   160→	}
   161→
   162→	// For remaining incomplete roots, assemble what is available.
   163→	incompleteSidecarsByRoot, missingByRoot, err := assembleAvailableSidecars(params.Storage, requestedIndices, incompleteRoots, directSidecarsByRoot)
   164→	if err != nil {
   165→		return nil, nil, errors.Wrap(err, "assemble available sidecars for incomplete roots")
   166→	}
   167→
   168→	for root, sidecars := range incompleteSidecarsByRoot {
   169→		result[root] = sidecars
   170→	}
   171→
   172→	log.WithField("finalMissingRootCount", len(incompleteRoots)).Debug("Failed to fetch data column sidecars from storage and peers using rescue mode")
   173→	return result, missingByRoot, nil
   174→}
   175→
   176→// requestSidecarsFromStorage attempts to retrieve data column sidecars for each block root in `roots`
   177→// and for all indices specified in `requestedIndices`.
   178→//
   179→// If not all requested sidecars can be obtained for a given root, that root is excluded from the result.
   180→// It returns a map from each root to its successfully retrieved sidecars.
   181→//
   182→// WARNING: This function mutates `roots` by removing entries for which all requested sidecars
   183→// were successfully retrieved.
   184→func requestSidecarsFromStorage(
   185→	storage filesystem.DataColumnStorageReader,
   186→	storedIndicesByRoot map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool,
   187→	requestedIndicesMap map[uint64]bool,
   188→	roots map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]bool,
   189→) (map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte][]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn, error) {
   190→	requestedIndices := sortedSliceFromMap(requestedIndicesMap)
   191→
   192→	result := make(map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte][]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn, len(roots))
   193→
   194→	for root := range roots {
   195→		storedIndices := storedIndicesByRoot[root]
   196→
   197→		// Check if all requested indices are stored.
   198→		allAvailable := true
   199→		for index := range requestedIndicesMap {
   200→			if !storedIndices[index] {
   201→				allAvailable = false
   202→				break
   203→			}
   204→		}
   205→
   206→		// Skip if not all requested indices are stored.
   207→		if !allAvailable {
   208→			continue
   209→		}
   210→
   211→		// All requested indices are stored, retrieve them.
   212→		verifiedRoSidecars, err := storage.Get(root, requestedIndices)
   213→		if err != nil {
   214→			return nil, errors.Wrapf(err, "storage get for block root %#x", root)
   215→		}
   216→
   217→		result[root] = verifiedRoSidecars
   218→		delete(roots, root)
   219→	}
   220→
   221→	return result, nil
   222→}
   223→
   224→// requestDirectSidecarsFromPeers tries to fetch missing data column sidecars from connected peers.
   225→// It searches through the available peers to identify those responsible for the requested columns,
   226→// and returns only after all columns have either been successfully retrieved or all candidate peers
   227→// have been exhausted.
   228→//
   229→// It returns a map from each root to its successfully retrieved sidecars.
   230→func requestDirectSidecarsFromPeers(
   231→	params DataColumnSidecarsParams,
   232→	slotByRoot map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]primitives.Slot,
   233→	requestedIndices map[uint64]bool,
   234→	slotsWithCommitments map[primitives.Slot]bool,
   235→	storedIndicesByRoot map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool,
   236→	incompleteRoots map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]bool,
   237→) (map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte][]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn, error) {
   238→	start := time.Now()
   239→
   240→	// Create a new random source for peer selection.
   241→	randomSource := rand.NewGenerator()
   242→
   243→	// Determine all sidecars each peers are expected to custody.
   244→	connectedPeersSlice := params.P2P.Peers().Connected()
   245→	connectedPeers := make(map[goPeer.ID]bool, len(connectedPeersSlice))
   246→	for _, peer := range connectedPeersSlice {
   247→		connectedPeers[peer] = true
   248→	}
   249→
   250→	// Compute missing indices by root, excluding those already in storage.
   251→	missingIndicesByRoot := make(map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool, len(incompleteRoots))
   252→	for root := range incompleteRoots {
   253→		storedIndices := storedIndicesByRoot[root]
   254→
   255→		missingIndices := make(map[uint64]bool, len(requestedIndices))
   256→		for index := range requestedIndices {
   257→			if !storedIndices[index] {
   258→				missingIndices[index] = true
   259→			}
   260→		}
   261→
   262→		if len(missingIndices) > 0 {
   263→			missingIndicesByRoot[root] = missingIndices
   264→		}
   265→	}
   266→
   267→	initialMissingCount := computeTotalCount(missingIndicesByRoot)
   268→
   269→	indicesByRootByPeer, err := computeIndicesByRootByPeer(params.P2P, slotByRoot, missingIndicesByRoot, connectedPeers)
   270→	if err != nil {
   271→		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "explore peers")
   272→	}
   273→
   274→	verifiedColumnsByRoot := make(map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte][]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn)
   275→	for len(missingIndicesByRoot) > 0 && len(indicesByRootByPeer) > 0 {
   276→		// Select peers to query the missing sidecars from.
   277→		indicesByRootByPeerToQuery, err := selectPeers(params, randomSource, len(missingIndicesByRoot), indicesByRootByPeer)
   278→		if err != nil {
   279→			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "select peers")
   280→		}
   281→
   282→		// Remove selected peers from the maps.
   283→		for peer := range indicesByRootByPeerToQuery {
   284→			delete(connectedPeers, peer)
   285→		}
   286→
   287→		// Fetch the sidecars from the chosen peers.
   288→		roDataColumnsByPeer := fetchDataColumnSidecarsFromPeers(params, slotByRoot, slotsWithCommitments, indicesByRootByPeerToQuery)
   289→
   290→		// Verify the received data column sidecars.
   291→		verifiedRoDataColumnSidecars, err := verifyDataColumnSidecarsByPeer(params.P2P, params.NewVerifier, roDataColumnsByPeer)
   292→		if err != nil {
   293→			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "verify data columns sidecars by peer")
   294→		}
   295→
   296→		// Remove the verified sidecars from the missing indices map and compute the new verified columns by root.
   297→		localVerifiedColumnsByRoot := updateResults(verifiedRoDataColumnSidecars, missingIndicesByRoot)
   298→		for root, verifiedRoDataColumns := range localVerifiedColumnsByRoot {
   299→			verifiedColumnsByRoot[root] = append(verifiedColumnsByRoot[root], verifiedRoDataColumns...)
   300→		}
   301→
   302→		// Compute indices by root by peers with the updated missing indices and connected peers.
   303→		indicesByRootByPeer, err = computeIndicesByRootByPeer(params.P2P, slotByRoot, missingIndicesByRoot, connectedPeers)
   304→		if err != nil {
   305→			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "explore peers")
   306→		}
   307→	}
   308→
   309→	log.WithFields(logrus.Fields{
   310→		"duration":            time.Since(start),
   311→		"initialMissingCount": initialMissingCount,
   312→		"finalMissingCount":   computeTotalCount(missingIndicesByRoot),
   313→	}).Debug("Requested direct data column sidecars from peers")
   314→
   315→	return verifiedColumnsByRoot, nil
   316→}
   317→
   318→// requestIndirectSidecarsFromPeers requests, for all roots in `missingIndicesbyRootOrig`,
   319→// for all possible peers, taking into account sidecars available in `inputs` and in the storage,
   320→// all possible sidecars until either, for each root:
   321→// - all indices in `indices` are available, or
   322→// - enough sidecars are available to trigger a reconstruction, or
   323→// - all peers are exhausted.
   324→func requestIndirectSidecarsFromPeers(
   325→	p DataColumnSidecarsParams,
   326→	slotByRoot map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]primitives.Slot,
   327→	slotsWithCommitments map[primitives.Slot]bool,
   328→	storedIndicesByRoot map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool,
   329→	alreadyAvailableByRoot map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte][]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn,
   330→	requestedIndices map[uint64]bool,
   331→	roots map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]bool,
   332→) (map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte][]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn, error) {
   333→	start := time.Now()
   334→
   335→	numberOfColumns := params.BeaconConfig().NumberOfColumns
   336→	minimumColumnCountToReconstruct := peerdas.MinimumColumnCountToReconstruct()
   337→
   338→	// Create a new random source for peer selection.
   339→	randomSource := rand.NewGenerator()
   340→
   341→	// For each root compute all possible data column sidecar indices excluding
   342→	// those already stored or already available.
   343→	indicesToRetrieveByRoot := make(map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool)
   344→	for root := range roots {
   345→		alreadyAvailableIndices := make(map[uint64]bool, len(alreadyAvailableByRoot[root]))
   346→		for _, sidecar := range alreadyAvailableByRoot[root] {
   347→			alreadyAvailableIndices[sidecar.Index] = true
   348→		}
   349→
   350→		storedIndices := storedIndicesByRoot[root]
   351→		indicesToRetrieve := make(map[uint64]bool, numberOfColumns)
   352→		for index := range numberOfColumns {
   353→			if !(storedIndices[index] || alreadyAvailableIndices[index]) {
   354→				indicesToRetrieve[index] = true
   355→			}
   356→		}
   357→
   358→		if len(indicesToRetrieve) > 0 {
   359→			indicesToRetrieveByRoot[root] = indicesToRetrieve
   360→		}
   361→	}
   362→
   363→	initialToRetrieveRootCount := len(indicesToRetrieveByRoot)
   364→
   365→	// Determine all sidecars each peers are expected to custody.
   366→	connectedPeersSlice := p.P2P.Peers().Connected()
   367→	connectedPeers := make(map[goPeer.ID]bool, len(connectedPeersSlice))
   368→	for _, peer := range connectedPeersSlice {
   369→		connectedPeers[peer] = true
   370→	}
   371→
   372→	// Compute which peers have which of the missing indices.
   373→	indicesByRootByPeer, err := computeIndicesByRootByPeer(p.P2P, slotByRoot, indicesToRetrieveByRoot, connectedPeers)
   374→	if err != nil {
   375→		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "explore peers")
   376→	}
   377→
   378→	// Already add into results all sidecars present in `alreadyAvailableByRoot`.
   379→	result := make(map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte][]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn)
   380→	for root := range roots {
   381→		alreadyAvailable := alreadyAvailableByRoot[root]
   382→		result[root] = append(result[root], alreadyAvailable...)
   383→	}
   384→
   385→	for len(indicesToRetrieveByRoot) > 0 && len(indicesByRootByPeer) > 0 {
   386→		// Select peers to query the missing sidecars from.
   387→		indicesByRootByPeerToQuery, err := selectPeers(p, randomSource, len(indicesToRetrieveByRoot), indicesByRootByPeer)
   388→		if err != nil {
   389→			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "select peers")
   390→		}
   391→
   392→		// Remove selected peers from the maps.
   393→		for peer := range indicesByRootByPeerToQuery {
   394→			delete(connectedPeers, peer)
   395→		}
   396→
   397→		// Fetch the sidecars from the chosen peers.
   398→		roDataColumnsByPeer := fetchDataColumnSidecarsFromPeers(p, slotByRoot, slotsWithCommitments, indicesByRootByPeerToQuery)
   399→
   400→		// Verify the received data column sidecars.
   401→		verifiedRoDataColumnSidecars, err := verifyDataColumnSidecarsByPeer(p.P2P, p.NewVerifier, roDataColumnsByPeer)
   402→		if err != nil {
   403→			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "verify data columns sidecars by peer")
   404→		}
   405→
   406→		// Add to results all verified sidecars.
   407→		localVerifiedColumnsByRoot := updateResults(verifiedRoDataColumnSidecars, indicesToRetrieveByRoot)
   408→		for root, verifiedRoDataColumns := range localVerifiedColumnsByRoot {
   409→			result[root] = append(result[root], verifiedRoDataColumns...)
   410→		}
   411→
   412→		// Unlabel a root as to retrieve if enough sidecars are retrieved to enable a reconstruction,
   413→		// or if all requested sidecars are now available for this root.
   414→		for root, indicesToRetrieve := range indicesToRetrieveByRoot {
   415→			storedIndices := storedIndicesByRoot[root]
   416→			storedCount := uint64(len(storedIndices))
   417→			resultCount := uint64(len(result[root]))
   418→
   419→			if storedCount+resultCount >= minimumColumnCountToReconstruct {
   420→				delete(indicesToRetrieveByRoot, root)
   421→				continue
   422→			}
   423→
   424→			allRequestedIndicesAvailable := true
   425→			for index := range requestedIndices {
   426→				if indicesToRetrieve[index] {
   427→					// Still need this index.
   428→					allRequestedIndicesAvailable = false
   429→					break
   430→				}
   431→			}
   432→
   433→			if allRequestedIndicesAvailable {
   434→				delete(indicesToRetrieveByRoot, root)
   435→			}
   436→		}
   437→
   438→		// Compute indices by root by peers with the updated missing indices and connected peers.
   439→		indicesByRootByPeer, err = computeIndicesByRootByPeer(p.P2P, slotByRoot, indicesToRetrieveByRoot, connectedPeers)
   440→		if err != nil {
   441→			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "explore peers")
   442→		}
   443→	}
   444→
   445→	log.WithFields(logrus.Fields{
   446→		"duration":                   time.Since(start),
   447→		"initialToRetrieveRootCount": initialToRetrieveRootCount,
   448→		"finalToRetrieveRootCount":   len(indicesToRetrieveByRoot),
   449→	}).Debug("Requested all data column sidecars from peers")
   450→
   451→	return result, nil
   452→}
   453→
   454→// mergeAvailableSidecars retrieves missing data column sidecars by combining
   455→// what is available in storage with the sidecars provided in `alreadyAvailableByRoot`,
   456→// reconstructing them when necessary.
   457→//
   458→// The function works in two modes depending on sidecar availability:
   459→//   - If all requested sidecars are already available (no reconstruction needed),
   460→//     it simply returns them directly from storage and inputs.
   461→//   - If storage + inputs together provide enough sidecars to reconstruct all requested ones,
   462→//     it reconstructs and returns the requested sidecars.
   463→//
   464→// If a root cannot yield all requested sidecars, that root is omitted from the result.
   465→//
   466→// Note: It is assumed that no sidecar in `alreadyAvailableByRoot` is already present in storage.
   467→//
   468→// WARNING: This function mutates `roots`, removing any block roots
   469→// for which all requested sidecars were successfully retrieved.
   470→func mergeAvailableSidecars(
   471→	storage filesystem.DataColumnStorageReader,
   472→	requestedIndices map[uint64]bool,
   473→	storedIndicesByRoot map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool,
   474→	roots map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]bool,
   475→	alreadyAvailableByRoot map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte][]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn,
   476→) (map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte][]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn, error) {
   477→	minimumColumnsCountToReconstruct := peerdas.MinimumColumnCountToReconstruct()
   478→
   479→	result := make(map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte][]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn, len(roots))
   480→	for root := range roots {
   481→		storedIndices := storedIndicesByRoot[root]
   482→		alreadyAvailable := alreadyAvailableByRoot[root]
   483→
   484→		// Compute already available indices.
   485→		alreadyAvailableIndices := make(map[uint64]bool, len(alreadyAvailable))
   486→		for _, sidecar := range alreadyAvailable {
   487→			alreadyAvailableIndices[sidecar.Index] = true
   488→		}
   489→
   490→		// Check if reconstruction is needed.
   491→		isReconstructionNeeded := false
   492→		for index := range requestedIndices {
   493→			if !(storedIndices[index] || alreadyAvailableIndices[index]) {
   494→				isReconstructionNeeded = true
   495→				break
   496→			}
   497→		}
   498→
   499→		// Check if reconstruction is possible.
   500→		storedCount := uint64(len(storedIndices))
   501→		alreadyAvailableCount := uint64(len(alreadyAvailableIndices))
   502→		isReconstructionPossible := storedCount+alreadyAvailableCount >= minimumColumnsCountToReconstruct
   503→
   504→		// Skip if the reconstruction is needed and not possible.
   505→		if isReconstructionNeeded && !isReconstructionPossible {
   506→			continue
   507→		}
   508→
   509→		// Reconstruct if reconstruction is needed and possible.
   510→		if isReconstructionNeeded && isReconstructionPossible {
   511→			// Load all we have in the store.
   512→			stored, err := storage.Get(root, nil)
   513→			if err != nil {
   514→				return nil, errors.Wrapf(err, "storage get for root %#x", root)
   515→			}
   516→
   517→			allAvailable := make([]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn, 0, storedCount+alreadyAvailableCount)
   518→			allAvailable = append(allAvailable, stored...)
   519→			allAvailable = append(allAvailable, alreadyAvailable...)
   520→
   521→			// Attempt reconstruction.
   522→			reconstructedSidecars, err := peerdas.ReconstructDataColumnSidecars(allAvailable)
   523→			if err != nil {
   524→				return nil, errors.Wrapf(err, "reconstruct data column sidecars for root %#x", root)
   525→			}
   526→
   527→			// Select only sidecars we need.
   528→			for _, sidecar := range reconstructedSidecars {
   529→				if requestedIndices[sidecar.Index] {
   530→					result[root] = append(result[root], sidecar)
   531→				}
   532→			}
   533→
   534→			delete(roots, root)
   535→			continue
   536→		}
   537→
   538→		// Reconstruction is not needed, simply assemble what is available in storage and already available.
   539→		allAvailable, err := assembleAvailableSidecarsForRoot(storage, alreadyAvailableByRoot, root, requestedIndices)
   540→		if err != nil {
   541→			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "assemble available sidecars")
   542→		}
   543→
   544→		result[root] = allAvailable
   545→		delete(roots, root)
   546→	}
   547→
   548→	return result, nil
   549→}
   550→
   551→// assembleAvailableSidecars assembles all sidecars available in storage
   552→// and in `alreadyAvailableByRoot` corresponding to `roots`.
   553→// It also returns all missing indices by root.
   554→func assembleAvailableSidecars(
   555→	storage filesystem.DataColumnStorageReader,
   556→	requestedIndices map[uint64]bool,
   557→	roots map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]bool,
   558→	alreadyAvailableByRoot map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte][]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn,
   559→) (map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte][]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn, map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool, error) {
   560→	// Assemble results.
   561→	result := make(map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte][]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn, len(roots))
   562→	for root := range roots {
   563→		allAvailable, err := assembleAvailableSidecarsForRoot(storage, alreadyAvailableByRoot, root, requestedIndices)
   564→		if err != nil {
   565→			return nil, nil, errors.Wrap(err, "assemble sidecars for root")
   566→		}
   567→
   568→		if len(allAvailable) > 0 {
   569→			result[root] = allAvailable
   570→		}
   571→	}
   572→
   573→	// Compute still missing sidecars.
   574→	missingByRoot := make(map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool, len(roots))
   575→	for root := range roots {
   576→		missing := make(map[uint64]bool, len(requestedIndices))
   577→		for index := range requestedIndices {
   578→			missing[index] = true
   579→		}
   580→
   581→		allAvailable := result[root]
   582→		for _, sidecar := range allAvailable {
   583→			delete(missing, sidecar.Index)
   584→		}
   585→
   586→		if len(missing) > 0 {
   587→			missingByRoot[root] = missing
   588→		}
   589→	}
   590→
   591→	return result, missingByRoot, nil
   592→}
   593→
   594→// assembleAvailableSidecarsForRoot assembles all sidecars available in storage
   595→// and in `alreadyAvailableByRoot` corresponding to `root` and `indices`.
   596→func assembleAvailableSidecarsForRoot(
   597→	storage filesystem.DataColumnStorageReader,
   598→	alreadyAvailableByRoot map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte][]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn,
   599→	root [fieldparams.RootLength]byte,
   600→	indices map[uint64]bool,
   601→) ([]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn, error) {
   602→	stored, err := storage.Get(root, sortedSliceFromMap(indices))
   603→	if err != nil {
   604→		return nil, errors.Wrapf(err, "storage get for root %#x", root)
   605→	}
   606→
   607→	alreadyAvailable := alreadyAvailableByRoot[root]
   608→
   609→	allAvailable := make([]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn, 0, len(stored)+len(alreadyAvailable))
   610→	allAvailable = append(allAvailable, stored...)
   611→	allAvailable = append(allAvailable, alreadyAvailable...)
   612→
   613→	return allAvailable, nil
   614→}
   615→
   616→// selectPeers selects peers to query the sidecars.
   617→// It begins by randomly selecting a peer in `origIndicesByRootByPeer` that has enough bandwidth,
   618→// and assigns to it all its available sidecars. Then, it randomly select an other peer, until
   619→// all sidecars in `missingIndicesByRoot` are covered.
   620→func selectPeers(
   621→	p DataColumnSidecarsParams,
   622→	randomSource *rand.Rand,
   623→	count int,
   624→	origIndicesByRootByPeer map[goPeer.ID]map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool,
   625→) (map[goPeer.ID]map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool, error) {
   626→	const randomPeerTimeout = 2 * time.Minute
   627→
   628→	// Select peers to query the missing sidecars from.
   629→	indicesByRootByPeer := copyIndicesByRootByPeer(origIndicesByRootByPeer)
   630→	internalIndicesByRootByPeer := copyIndicesByRootByPeer(indicesByRootByPeer)
   631→	indicesByRootByPeerToQuery := make(map[goPeer.ID]map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool)
   632→	for len(internalIndicesByRootByPeer) > 0 {
   633→		// Randomly select a peer with enough bandwidth.
   634→		peer, err := func() (goPeer.ID, error) {
   635→			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(p.Ctx, randomPeerTimeout)
   636→			defer cancel()
   637→
   638→			peer, err := randomPeer(ctx, randomSource, p.RateLimiter, count, internalIndicesByRootByPeer)
   639→			if err != nil {
   640→				return "", errors.Wrap(err, "select random peer")
   641→			}
   642→
   643→			return peer, err
   644→		}()
   645→		if err != nil {
   646→			return nil, err
   647→		}
   648→
   649→		// Query all the sidecars that peer can offer us.
   650→		newIndicesByRoot, ok := internalIndicesByRootByPeer[peer]
   651→		if !ok {
   652→			return nil, errors.Errorf("peer %s not found in internal indices by root by peer map", peer)
   653→		}
   654→
   655→		indicesByRootByPeerToQuery[peer] = newIndicesByRoot
   656→
   657→		// Remove this peer from the maps to avoid re-selection.
   658→		delete(indicesByRootByPeer, peer)
   659→		delete(internalIndicesByRootByPeer, peer)
   660→
   661→		// Delete the corresponding sidecars from other peers in the internal map
   662→		// to avoid re-selection during this iteration.
   663→		for peer, indicesByRoot := range internalIndicesByRootByPeer {
   664→			for root, indices := range indicesByRoot {
   665→				newIndices := newIndicesByRoot[root]
   666→				for index := range newIndices {
   667→					delete(indices, index)
   668→				}
   669→				if len(indices) == 0 {
   670→					delete(indicesByRoot, root)
   671→				}
   672→			}
   673→			if len(indicesByRoot) == 0 {
   674→				delete(internalIndicesByRootByPeer, peer)
   675→			}
   676→		}
   677→	}
   678→
   679→	return indicesByRootByPeerToQuery, nil
   680→}

   682→// updateResults updates the missing indices and verified sidecars maps based on the newly verified sidecars.
   683→// WARNING: This function alters `missingIndicesByRoot` by removing verified sidecars.
   684→// After running this function, the user can check the content of the (modified) `missingIndicesByRoot` map
   685→// to check if some sidecars are still missing.
   686→func updateResults(
   687→	verifiedSidecars []blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn,
   688→	missingIndicesByRoot map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool,
   689→) map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte][]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn {
   690→	verifiedSidecarsByRoot := make(map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte][]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn)
   691→	for _, verifiedSidecar := range verifiedSidecars {
   692→		blockRoot := verifiedSidecar.BlockRoot()
   693→		index := verifiedSidecar.Index
   694→
   695→		// Add to the result map grouped by block root
   696→		verifiedSidecarsByRoot[blockRoot] = append(verifiedSidecarsByRoot[blockRoot], verifiedSidecar)
   697→
   698→		if indices, ok := missingIndicesByRoot[blockRoot]; ok {
   699→			delete(indices, index)
   700→			if len(indices) == 0 {
   701→				delete(missingIndicesByRoot, blockRoot)
   702→			}
   703→		}
   704→	}
   705→
   706→	return verifiedSidecarsByRoot
   707→}

   709→// fetchDataColumnSidecarsFromPeers retrieves data column sidecars from peers.
   710→func fetchDataColumnSidecarsFromPeers(
   711→	params DataColumnSidecarsParams,
   712→	slotByRoot map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]primitives.Slot,
   713→	slotsWithCommitments map[primitives.Slot]bool,
   714→	indicesByRootByPeer map[goPeer.ID]map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool,
   715→) map[goPeer.ID][]blocks.RODataColumn {
   716→	var (
   717→		wg  sync.WaitGroup
   718→		mut sync.Mutex
   719→	)
   720→
   721→	roDataColumnsByPeer := make(map[goPeer.ID][]blocks.RODataColumn)
   722→	wg.Add(len(indicesByRootByPeer))
   723→	for peerID, indicesByRoot := range indicesByRootByPeer {
   724→		go func(peerID goPeer.ID, indicesByRoot map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool) {
   725→			defer wg.Done()
   726→
   727→			requestedCount := 0
   728→			for _, indices := range indicesByRoot {
   729→				requestedCount += len(indices)
   730→			}
   731→
   732→			log := log.WithFields(logrus.Fields{
   733→				"peerID":              peerID,
   734→				"agent":               agentString(peerID, params.P2P.Host()),
   735→				"blockCount":          len(indicesByRoot),
   736→				"totalRequestedCount": requestedCount,
   737→			})
   738→
   739→			roDataColumns, err := sendDataColumnSidecarsRequest(params, slotByRoot, slotsWithCommitments, peerID, indicesByRoot)
   740→			if err != nil {
   741→				log.WithError(err).Warning("Failed to send data column sidecars request")
   742→				return
   743→			}
   744→
   745→			mut.Lock()
   746→			defer mut.Unlock()
   747→			roDataColumnsByPeer[peerID] = roDataColumns
   748→		}(peerID, indicesByRoot)
   749→	}
   750→
   751→	wg.Wait()
   752→
   753→	return roDataColumnsByPeer
   754→}
   755→
   756→func sendDataColumnSidecarsRequest(
   757→	params DataColumnSidecarsParams,
   758→	slotByRoot map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]primitives.Slot,
   759→	slotsWithCommitments map[primitives.Slot]bool,
   760→	peerID goPeer.ID,
   761→	indicesByRoot map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool,
   762→) ([]blocks.RODataColumn, error) {
   763→	const batchSize = 32
   764→
   765→	rootCount := int64(len(indicesByRoot))
   766→	requestedSidecarsCount := 0
   767→	for _, indices := range indicesByRoot {
   768→		requestedSidecarsCount += len(indices)
   769→	}
   770→
   771→	log := log.WithFields(logrus.Fields{
   772→		"peerID":            peerID,
   773→		"agent":             agentString(peerID, params.P2P.Host()),
   774→		"requestedSidecars": requestedSidecarsCount,
   775→	})
   776→
   777→	// Try to build a by range byRangeRequest first.
   778→	byRangeRequests, err := buildByRangeRequests(slotByRoot, slotsWithCommitments, indicesByRoot, batchSize)
   779→	if err != nil {
   780→		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "craft by range request")
   781→	}
   782→
   783→	// If we have a valid by range request, send it.
   784→	if len(byRangeRequests) > 0 {
   785→		count := 0
   786→		for _, indices := range indicesByRoot {
   787→			count += len(indices)
   788→		}
   789→
   790→		start := time.Now()
   791→		roDataColumns := make([]blocks.RODataColumn, 0, count)
   792→		for _, request := range byRangeRequests {
   793→			if params.RateLimiter != nil {
   794→				params.RateLimiter.Add(peerID.String(), rootCount)
   795→			}
   796→
   797→			localRoDataColumns, err := SendDataColumnSidecarsByRangeRequest(params, peerID, request)
   798→			if err != nil {
   799→				return nil, errors.Wrapf(err, "send data column sidecars by range request to peer %s", peerID)
   800→			}
   801→
   802→			roDataColumns = append(roDataColumns, localRoDataColumns...)
   803→		}
   804→
   805→		prettyByRangeRequests := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(byRangeRequests))
   806→		for _, request := range byRangeRequests {
   807→			prettyRequest := map[string]any{
   808→				"startSlot": request.StartSlot,
   809→				"count":     request.Count,
   810→				"columns":   request.Columns,
   811→			}
   812→
   813→			prettyByRangeRequests = append(prettyByRangeRequests, prettyRequest)
   814→		}
   815→
   816→		log.WithFields(logrus.Fields{
   817→			"respondedSidecars": len(roDataColumns),
   818→			"requestCount":      len(byRangeRequests),
   819→			"type":              "byRange",
   820→			"duration":          time.Since(start),
   821→			"requests":          prettyByRangeRequests,
   822→		}).Debug("Received data column sidecars")
   823→
   824→		return roDataColumns, nil
   825→	}
   826→
   827→	// Build identifiers for the by root request.
   828→	byRootRequest := buildByRootRequest(indicesByRoot)
   829→
   830→	// Send the by root request.
   831→	start := time.Now()
   832→	if params.RateLimiter != nil {
   833→		params.RateLimiter.Add(peerID.String(), rootCount)
   834→	}
   835→	roDataColumns, err := SendDataColumnSidecarsByRootRequest(params, peerID, byRootRequest)
   836→	if err != nil {
   837→		return nil, errors.Wrapf(err, "send data column sidecars by root request to peer %s", peerID)
   838→	}
   839→
   840→	log.WithFields(logrus.Fields{
   841→		"respondedSidecars": len(roDataColumns),
   842→		"requests":          1,
   843→		"type":              "byRoot",
   844→		"duration":          time.Since(start),
   845→	}).Debug("Received data column sidecars")
   846→
   847→	return roDataColumns, nil
   848→}
   849→
   850→// buildByRangeRequests constructs a by range request from the given indices,
   851→// only if the indices are the same all blocks and if the blocks are contiguous.
   852→// (Missing blocks or blocks without commitments do count as contiguous)
   853→// If one of this condition is not met, returns nil.
   854→func buildByRangeRequests(
   855→	slotByRoot map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]primitives.Slot,
   856→	slotsWithCommitments map[primitives.Slot]bool,
   857→	indicesByRoot map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool,
   858→	batchSize uint64,
   859→) ([]*ethpb.DataColumnSidecarsByRangeRequest, error) {
   860→	if len(indicesByRoot) == 0 {
   861→		return nil, nil
   862→	}
   863→
   864→	var reference map[uint64]bool
   865→	slots := make([]primitives.Slot, 0, len(slotByRoot))
   866→	for root, indices := range indicesByRoot {
   867→		if reference == nil {
   868→			reference = indices
   869→		}
   870→
   871→		if !compareIndices(reference, indices) {
   872→			return nil, nil
   873→		}
   874→
   875→		slot, ok := slotByRoot[root]
   876→		if !ok {
   877→			return nil, errors.Errorf("slot not found for block root %#x", root)
   878→		}
   879→
   880→		slots = append(slots, slot)
   881→	}
   882→
   883→	slices.Sort(slots)
   884→
   885→	for i := 1; i < len(slots); i++ {
   886→		previous, current := slots[i-1], slots[i]
   887→		if current == previous+1 {
   888→			continue
   889→		}
   890→
   891→		for j := previous + 1; j < current; j++ {
   892→			if slotsWithCommitments[j] {
   893→				return nil, nil
   894→			}
   895→		}
   896→	}
   897→
   898→	columns := sortedSliceFromMap(reference)
   899→	startSlot, endSlot := slots[0], slots[len(slots)-1]
   900→	totalCount := uint64(endSlot - startSlot + 1)
   901→
   902→	requests := make([]*ethpb.DataColumnSidecarsByRangeRequest, 0, totalCount/batchSize)
   903→	for start := startSlot; start <= endSlot; start += primitives.Slot(batchSize) {
   904→		end := min(start+primitives.Slot(batchSize)-1, endSlot)
   905→		request := &ethpb.DataColumnSidecarsByRangeRequest{
   906→			StartSlot: start,
   907→			Count:     uint64(end - start + 1),
   908→			Columns:   columns,
   909→		}
   910→
   911→		requests = append(requests, request)
   912→	}
   913→
   914→	return requests, nil
   915→}
   916→
   917→// buildByRootRequest constructs a by root request from the given indices.
   918→func buildByRootRequest(indicesByRoot map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool) p2ptypes.DataColumnsByRootIdentifiers {
   919→	identifiers := make(p2ptypes.DataColumnsByRootIdentifiers, 0, len(indicesByRoot))
   920→	for root, indices := range indicesByRoot {
   921→		identifier := &eth.DataColumnsByRootIdentifier{
   922→			BlockRoot: root[:],
   923→			Columns:   sortedSliceFromMap(indices),
   924→		}
   925→		identifiers = append(identifiers, identifier)
   926→	}
   927→
   928→	// Sort identifiers to have a deterministic output.
   929→	slices.SortFunc(identifiers, func(left, right *eth.DataColumnsByRootIdentifier) int {
   930→		if cmp := bytes.Compare(left.BlockRoot, right.BlockRoot); cmp != 0 {
   931→			return cmp
   932→		}
   933→		return slices.Compare(left.Columns, right.Columns)
   934→	})
   935→
   936→	return identifiers
   937→}

   939→// verifyDataColumnSidecarsByPeer verifies the received data column sidecars.
   940→// If at least one sidecar from a peer is invalid, the peer is downscored and
   941→// all its sidecars are rejected. (Sidecars from other peers are still accepted.)
   942→func verifyDataColumnSidecarsByPeer(
   943→	p2p prysmP2P.P2P,
   944→	newVerifier verification.NewDataColumnsVerifier,
   945→	roDataColumnsByPeer map[goPeer.ID][]blocks.RODataColumn,
   946→) ([]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn, error) {
   947→	// First optimistically verify all received data columns in a single batch.
   948→	count := 0
   949→	for _, columns := range roDataColumnsByPeer {
   950→		count += len(columns)
   951→	}
   952→
   953→	roDataColumnSidecars := make([]blocks.RODataColumn, 0, count)
   954→	for _, columns := range roDataColumnsByPeer {
   955→		roDataColumnSidecars = append(roDataColumnSidecars, columns...)
   956→	}
   957→
   958→	verifiedRoDataColumnSidecars, err := verifyByRootDataColumnSidecars(newVerifier, roDataColumnSidecars)
   959→	if err == nil {
   960→		// This is the happy path where all sidecars are verified.
   961→		return verifiedRoDataColumnSidecars, nil
   962→	}
   963→
   964→	// An error occurred during verification, which means that at least one sidecar is invalid.
   965→	// Reverify peer by peer to identify faulty peer(s), reject all its sidecars, and downscore it.
   966→	verifiedRoDataColumnSidecars = make([]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn, 0, count)
   967→	for peer, columns := range roDataColumnsByPeer {
   968→		peerVerifiedRoDataColumnSidecars, err := verifyByRootDataColumnSidecars(newVerifier, columns)
   969→		if err != nil {
   970→			// This peer has invalid sidecars.
   971→			log := log.WithError(err).WithField("peerID", peer)
   972→			newScore := p2p.Peers().Scorers().BadResponsesScorer().Increment(peer)
   973→			log.Warning("Peer returned invalid data column sidecars")
   974→			log.WithFields(logrus.Fields{"reason": "invalidDataColumnSidecars", "newScore": newScore}).Debug("Downscore peer")
   975→		}
   976→
   977→		verifiedRoDataColumnSidecars = append(verifiedRoDataColumnSidecars, peerVerifiedRoDataColumnSidecars...)
   978→	}
   979→
   980→	return verifiedRoDataColumnSidecars, nil
   981→}
   982→
   983→// verifyByRootDataColumnSidecars verifies the provided read-only data columns against the
   984→// requirements for data column sidecars received via the by root request.
   985→func verifyByRootDataColumnSidecars(newVerifier verification.NewDataColumnsVerifier, roDataColumns []blocks.RODataColumn) ([]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn, error) {
   986→	verifier := newVerifier(roDataColumns, verification.ByRootRequestDataColumnSidecarRequirements)
   987→
   988→	if err := verifier.ValidFields(); err != nil {
   989→		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "valid fields")
   990→	}
   991→
   992→	if err := verifier.SidecarInclusionProven(); err != nil {
   993→		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "sidecar inclusion proven")
   994→	}
   995→
   996→	if err := verifier.SidecarKzgProofVerified(); err != nil {
   997→		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "sidecar KZG proof verified")
   998→	}
   999→
  1000→	verifiedRoDataColumns, err := verifier.VerifiedRODataColumns()
  1001→	if err != nil {
  1002→		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "verified RO data columns - should never happen")
  1003→	}
  1004→
  1005→	return verifiedRoDataColumns, nil
  1006→}

  1008→// computeIndicesByRootByPeer returns a peers->root->indices map only for
  1009→// root and indices given in `indicesByBlockRoot`. It also only selects peers
  1010→// for a given root only if its head state is higher than the block slot.
  1011→func computeIndicesByRootByPeer(
  1012→	p2p prysmP2P.P2P,
  1013→	slotByBlockRoot map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]primitives.Slot,
  1014→	indicesByBlockRoot map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool,
  1015→	peers map[goPeer.ID]bool,
  1016→) (map[goPeer.ID]map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool, error) {
  1017→	slotsPerEpoch := params.BeaconConfig().SlotsPerEpoch
  1018→
  1019→	// First, compute custody columns for all peers
  1020→	peersByIndex := make(map[uint64]map[goPeer.ID]bool)
  1021→	headSlotByPeer := make(map[goPeer.ID]primitives.Slot)
  1022→	for peer := range peers {
  1023→		// Computes the custody columns for each peer
  1024→		nodeID, err := prysmP2P.ConvertPeerIDToNodeID(peer)
  1025→		if err != nil {
  1026→			return nil, errors.Wrapf(err, "convert peer ID to node ID for peer %s", peer)
  1027→		}
  1028→
  1029→		custodyGroupCount := p2p.CustodyGroupCountFromPeer(peer)
  1030→
  1031→		dasInfo, _, err := peerdas.Info(nodeID, custodyGroupCount)
  1032→		if err != nil {
  1033→			return nil, errors.Wrapf(err, "peerdas info for peer %s", peer)
  1034→		}
  1035→
  1036→		for column := range dasInfo.CustodyColumns {
  1037→			if _, exists := peersByIndex[column]; !exists {
  1038→				peersByIndex[column] = make(map[goPeer.ID]bool)
  1039→			}
  1040→			peersByIndex[column][peer] = true
  1041→		}
  1042→
  1043→		// Compute the head slot for each peer
  1044→		peerChainState, err := p2p.Peers().ChainState(peer)
  1045→		if err != nil {
  1046→			return nil, errors.Wrapf(err, "get chain state for peer %s", peer)
  1047→		}
  1048→
  1049→		if peerChainState == nil {
  1050→			return nil, errors.Errorf("chain state is nil for peer %s", peer)
  1051→		}
  1052→
  1053→		// Our view of the head slot of a peer is not updated in real time.
  1054→		// We add an epoch to take into account the fact the real head slot of the peer
  1055→		// is higher than our view of it.
  1056→		headSlotByPeer[peer] = peerChainState.HeadSlot + slotsPerEpoch
  1057→	}
  1058→
  1059→	// For each block root and its indices, find suitable peers
  1060→	indicesByRootByPeer := make(map[goPeer.ID]map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool)
  1061→	for blockRoot, indices := range indicesByBlockRoot {
  1062→		blockSlot, ok := slotByBlockRoot[blockRoot]
  1063→		if !ok {
  1064→			return nil, errors.Errorf("slot not found for block root %#x", blockRoot)
  1065→		}
  1066→
  1067→		for index := range indices {
  1068→			peers := peersByIndex[index]
  1069→			for peer := range peers {
  1070→				peerHeadSlot, ok := headSlotByPeer[peer]
  1071→				if !ok {
  1072→					return nil, errors.Errorf("head slot not found for peer %s", peer)
  1073→				}
  1074→
  1075→				if peerHeadSlot < blockSlot {
  1076→					continue
  1077→				}
  1078→
  1079→				// Build peers->root->indices map
  1080→				if _, exists := indicesByRootByPeer[peer]; !exists {
  1081→					indicesByRootByPeer[peer] = make(map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool)
  1082→				}
  1083→				if _, exists := indicesByRootByPeer[peer][blockRoot]; !exists {
  1084→					indicesByRootByPeer[peer][blockRoot] = make(map[uint64]bool)
  1085→				}
  1086→				indicesByRootByPeer[peer][blockRoot][index] = true
  1087→			}
  1088→		}
  1089→	}
  1090→
  1091→	return indicesByRootByPeer, nil
  1092→}

  1094→// randomPeer selects a random peer. If no peers has enough bandwidth, it will wait and retry.
  1095→// Returns the selected peer ID and any error.
  1096→func randomPeer(
  1097→	ctx context.Context,
  1098→	randomSource *rand.Rand,
  1099→	rateLimiter *leakybucket.Collector,
  1100→	count int,
  1101→	indicesByRootByPeer map[goPeer.ID]map[[fieldparams.RootLength]byte]map[uint64]bool,
  1102→) (goPeer.ID, error) {
  1103→	const waitPeriod = 5 * time.Second
  1104→
  1105→	peerCount := len(indicesByRootByPeer)
  1106→	if peerCount == 0 {
  1107→		return "", errors.New("no peers available")
  1108→	}
  1109→
  1110→	for ctx.Err() == nil {
  1111→		nonRateLimitedPeers := make([]goPeer.ID, 0, len(indicesByRootByPeer))
  1112→		for peer := range indicesByRootByPeer {
  1113→			if rateLimiter == nil || rateLimiter.Remaining(peer.String()) >= int64(count) {
  1114→				nonRateLimitedPeers = append(nonRateLimitedPeers, peer)
  1115→			}
  1116→		}
  1117→
  1118→		slices.Sort(nonRateLimitedPeers)
  1119→
  1120→		if len(nonRateLimitedPeers) == 0 {
  1121→			log.WithFields(logrus.Fields{
  1122→				"peerCount": peerCount,
  1123→				"delay":     waitPeriod,
  1124→			}).Debug("Waiting for a peer with enough bandwidth for data column sidecars")
  1125→			time.Sleep(waitPeriod)
  1126→			continue
  1127→		}
  1128→
  1129→		randomIndex := randomSource.Intn(len(nonRateLimitedPeers))
  1130→		return nonRateLimitedPeers[randomIndex], nil
  1131→	}
  1132→
  1133→	return "", ctx.Err()
  1134→}
  1135→

    31→	request, ok := msg.(*pb.DataColumnSidecarsByRangeRequest)

    33→		return notDataColumnsByRangeIdentifiersError

    36→	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, respTimeout)
    37→	defer cancel()

    39→	SetRPCStreamDeadlines(stream)
    40→	beaconConfig := params.BeaconConfig()
    41→	maxRequestDataColumnSidecars := beaconConfig.MaxRequestDataColumnSidecars
    42→	remotePeer := stream.Conn().RemotePeer()
    43→

    45→

    47→	var requestedColumnsLog interface{} = "all"
    48→	if uint64(len(requestedColumns)) != beaconConfig.NumberOfColumns {
    49→		requestedColumnsLog = requestedColumns
    50→	}
    51→

    53→		"remotePeer":       remotePeer,
    54→		"requestedColumns": requestedColumnsLog,
    55→		"startSlot":        request.StartSlot,
    56→		"count":            request.Count,
    57→	})
    58→

    60→	if err := s.rateLimiter.validateRequest(stream, rateLimitingAmount); err != nil {
    61→		return errors.Wrap(err, "rate limiter validate request")
    62→	}
    63→
    64→	// Validate the request regarding its parameters.

    71→	}

    73→		log.Debug("No data columns by range to serve")
    74→		return nil
    75→	}
    76→
    77→	log.Debug("Serving data columns by range request")
    78→
    79→	// Ticker to stagger out large requests.
    80→	ticker := time.NewTicker(time.Second)
    81→
    82→	batcher, err := newBlockRangeBatcher(*rangeParameters, s.cfg.beaconDB, s.rateLimiter, s.cfg.chain.IsCanonical, ticker)
    83→	if err != nil {
    84→		s.writeErrorResponseToStream(responseCodeServerError, p2ptypes.ErrGeneric.Error(), stream)

   100→		rpcDataColumnsByRangeResponseLatency.Observe(float64(time.Since(batchStart).Milliseconds()))

   103→		}
   104→

   106→		if maxRequestDataColumnSidecars == 0 {
   107→			log.WithField("initialQuota", beaconConfig.MaxRequestDataColumnSidecars).Debug("Reached quota for data column sidecars by range request")

   109→		}
   110→	}

   112→	if err := batch.error(); err != nil {

   128→func (s *Service) streamDataColumnBatch(ctx context.Context, batch blockBatch, quota uint64, wantedDataColumnIndices []uint64, stream libp2pcore.Stream) (uint64, error) {
   129→	_, span := trace.StartSpan(ctx, "sync.streamDataColumnBatch")
   130→	defer span.End()
   131→
   132→	// Defensive check to guard against underflow.
   133→	if quota == 0 {
   134→		return 0, nil
   135→	}
   136→
   137→	// Loop over the blocks in the batch.
   138→	for _, block := range batch.canonical() {
   139→		// Get the block blockRoot.
   140→		blockRoot := block.Root()
   141→
   142→		// Retrieve the data column sidecars from the store.
   143→		verifiedRODataColumns, err := s.cfg.dataColumnStorage.Get(blockRoot, wantedDataColumnIndices)
   144→		if err != nil {
   145→			s.writeErrorResponseToStream(responseCodeServerError, p2ptypes.ErrGeneric.Error(), stream)
   146→			return quota, errors.Wrapf(err, "get data column sidecars: block root %#x", blockRoot)
   147→		}
   148→
   149→		// Write the retrieved sidecars to the stream.
   150→		for _, verifiedRODataColumn := range verifiedRODataColumns {
   151→			sidecar := verifiedRODataColumn.DataColumnSidecar
   152→			SetStreamWriteDeadline(stream, defaultWriteDuration)
   153→
   154→			if err := WriteDataColumnSidecarChunk(stream, s.cfg.clock, s.cfg.p2p.Encoding(), sidecar); err != nil {
   155→				s.writeErrorResponseToStream(responseCodeServerError, p2ptypes.ErrGeneric.Error(), stream)
   156→				tracing.AnnotateError(span, err)
   157→				return quota, errors.Wrap(err, "write data column sidecar chunk")
   158→			}
   159→
   160→			s.rateLimiter.add(stream, rateLimitingAmount)
   161→			quota -= 1
   162→
   163→			// Stop streaming results once the quota of writes for the request is consumed.
   164→			if quota == 0 {
   165→				return 0, nil
   166→			}
   167→		}
   168→	}
   169→
   170→	return quota, nil
   171→}

   173→func validateDataColumnsByRange(request *pb.DataColumnSidecarsByRangeRequest, currentSlot primitives.Slot) (*rangeParams, error) {
   174→	startSlot, count := request.StartSlot, request.Count
   175→
   176→	if count == 0 {
   177→		return nil, errors.Wrap(p2ptypes.ErrInvalidRequest, "invalid request count parameter")
   178→	}
   179→
   180→	endSlot, err := request.StartSlot.SafeAdd(count - 1)
   181→	if err != nil {
   182→		return nil, errors.Wrap(p2ptypes.ErrInvalidRequest, "overflow start + count -1")
   183→	}
   184→
   185→	// Peers may overshoot the current slot when in initial sync,
   186→	// so we don't want to penalize them by treating the request as an error.
   187→	if startSlot > currentSlot {
   188→		return nil, nil
   189→	}
   190→
   191→	// Compute the oldest slot we'll allow a peer to request, based on the current slot.
   192→	minStartSlot, err := dataColumnsRPCMinValidSlot(currentSlot)
   193→	if err != nil {
   194→		return nil, errors.Wrap(p2ptypes.ErrInvalidRequest, "data columns RPC min valid slot")
   195→	}
   196→
   197→	// Return early if there is nothing to serve.
   198→	if endSlot < minStartSlot {
   199→		return nil, nil
   200→	}
   201→
   202→	// Do not serve sidecars for slots before the minimum valid slot or after the current slot.
   203→	startSlot = max(startSlot, minStartSlot)
   204→	endSlot = min(endSlot, currentSlot)
   205→
   206→	sizeMinusOne, err := endSlot.SafeSub(uint64(startSlot))
   207→	if err != nil {
   208→		return nil, errors.Errorf("overflow end - start: %d - %d - should never happen", endSlot, startSlot)
   209→	}
   210→
   211→	size, err := sizeMinusOne.SafeAdd(1)
   212→	if err != nil {
   213→		return nil, errors.Wrap(p2ptypes.ErrInvalidRequest, "overflow end - start + 1")
   214→	}
   215→
   216→	rangeParameters := &rangeParams{start: startSlot, end: endSlot, size: uint64(size)}
   217→	return rangeParameters, nil
   218→}

    32→// VerifyDataColumnSidecar verifies if the data column sidecar is valid.
    33→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/p2p-interface.md#verify_data_column_sidecar
    34→func VerifyDataColumnSidecar(sidecar blocks.RODataColumn) error {
    35→	// The sidecar index must be within the valid range.
    36→	numberOfColumns := params.BeaconConfig().NumberOfColumns
    37→	if sidecar.Index >= numberOfColumns {
    38→		return ErrIndexTooLarge
    39→	}
    40→
    41→	// A sidecar for zero blobs is invalid.
    42→	if len(sidecar.KzgCommitments) == 0 {
    43→		return ErrNoKzgCommitments
    44→	}
    45→
    46→	// The column length must be equal to the number of commitments/proofs.
    47→	if len(sidecar.Column) != len(sidecar.KzgCommitments) || len(sidecar.Column) != len(sidecar.KzgProofs) {
    48→		return ErrMismatchLength
    49→	}
    50→
    51→	return nil
    52→}
    53→
    54→// VerifyDataColumnsSidecarKZGProofs verifies if the KZG proofs are correct.
    55→// Note: We are slightly deviating from the specification here:
    56→// The specification verifies the KZG proofs for each sidecar separately,
    57→// while we are verifying all the KZG proofs from multiple sidecars in a batch.
    58→// This is done to improve performance since the internal KZG library is way more
    59→// efficient when verifying in batch.
    60→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/p2p-interface.md#verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs
    61→func VerifyDataColumnsSidecarKZGProofs(sidecars []blocks.RODataColumn) error {
    62→	// Compute the total count.
    63→	count := 0
    64→	for _, sidecar := range sidecars {
    65→		count += len(sidecar.Column)
    66→	}
    67→
    68→	commitments := make([]kzg.Bytes48, 0, count)
    69→	indices := make([]uint64, 0, count)
    70→	cells := make([]kzg.Cell, 0, count)
    71→	proofs := make([]kzg.Bytes48, 0, count)
    72→
    73→	for _, sidecar := range sidecars {
    74→		for i := range sidecar.Column {
    75→			commitments = append(commitments, kzg.Bytes48(sidecar.KzgCommitments[i]))
    76→			indices = append(indices, sidecar.Index)
    77→			cells = append(cells, kzg.Cell(sidecar.Column[i]))
    78→			proofs = append(proofs, kzg.Bytes48(sidecar.KzgProofs[i]))
    79→		}
    80→	}
    81→
    82→	// Batch verify that the cells match the corresponding commitments and proofs.
    83→	verified, err := kzg.VerifyCellKZGProofBatch(commitments, indices, cells, proofs)
    84→	if err != nil {
    85→		return errors.Wrap(err, "verify cell KZG proof batch")
    86→	}
    87→
    88→	if !verified {
    89→		return ErrInvalidKZGProof
    90→	}
    91→
    92→	return nil
    93→}
    94→
    95→// VerifyDataColumnSidecarInclusionProof verifies if the given KZG commitments included in the given beacon block.
    96→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/p2p-interface.md#verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof
    97→func VerifyDataColumnSidecarInclusionProof(sidecar blocks.RODataColumn) error {
    98→	if sidecar.SignedBlockHeader == nil || sidecar.SignedBlockHeader.Header == nil {
    99→		return ErrNilBlockHeader
   100→	}
   101→
   102→	root := sidecar.SignedBlockHeader.Header.BodyRoot
   103→	if len(root) != fieldparams.RootLength {
   104→		return ErrBadRootLength
   105→	}
   106→
   107→	leaves := blocks.LeavesFromCommitments(sidecar.KzgCommitments)
   108→
   109→	sparse, err := trie.GenerateTrieFromItems(leaves, fieldparams.LogMaxBlobCommitments)
   110→	if err != nil {
   111→		return errors.Wrap(err, "generate trie from items")
   112→	}
   113→
   114→	hashTreeRoot, err := sparse.HashTreeRoot()
   115→	if err != nil {
   116→		return errors.Wrap(err, "hash tree root")
   117→	}
   118→
   119→	verified := trie.VerifyMerkleProof(root, hashTreeRoot[:], kzgPosition, sidecar.KzgCommitmentsInclusionProof)
   120→	if !verified {
   121→		return ErrInvalidInclusionProof
   122→	}
   123→
   124→	return nil
   125→}

   127→// ComputeSubnetForDataColumnSidecar computes the subnet for a data column sidecar.
   128→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/p2p-interface.md#compute_subnet_for_data_column_sidecar
   129→func ComputeSubnetForDataColumnSidecar(columnIndex uint64) uint64 {
   130→	dataColumnSidecarSubnetCount := params.BeaconConfig().DataColumnSidecarSubnetCount
   131→	return columnIndex % dataColumnSidecarSubnetCount
   132→}

   134→// DataColumnSubnets computes the subnets for the data columns.
   135→func DataColumnSubnets(dataColumns map[uint64]bool) map[uint64]bool {
   136→	subnets := make(map[uint64]bool, len(dataColumns))
   137→
   138→	for column := range dataColumns {
   139→		subnet := ComputeSubnetForDataColumnSidecar(column)
   140→		subnets[subnet] = true
   141→	}
   142→
   143→	return subnets
   144→}
